summary: APPROVE. Independent final review found no implementation-level blocking findings in subject 290254cc70791bcfa9895feab98154b411c2ef55. The isolated five-probe runner, Windows cleanup and containment behavior, fail-closed main-tree/worktree-registry checks, tests, Chapter 11.3 projection, and current 10/10 V1 evidence are consistent with the frozen specification. One medium governance naming ambiguity in the consumed V1 retry artifacts was resolved by an additive task-local clarification: full_v1_verification_rerun is only the retry-instance label for the canonical v1_verify transaction, not a third transaction type, and grants no new authority. Residual risks are the documented manual action-consumption fallback, absence of an OS network sandbox, and conservative cleanup failure under prolonged external Windows file locks.

resolution.reason: Added an immutable-preserving task-local clarification that canonically classifies TASK-0013-V1-002 as v1_verify, retains full_v1_verification_rerun only as its descriptive retry label, binds rerun_of to the consumed prior action, and explicitly grants no delete, retry, budget reuse, code approval, merge, deploy, or close authority.
